decisions.reason: As a homepage-featured extension of the firm’s core handcrafted seasonal décor, it likely performs at or near aspiration and is easy to support with existing skills and slack.
This product is very close to the established Christmas pyramid line, was prominently presented, and therefore would normally be retained unless results were clearly disappointing.

Although more distant from the traditional craft base because of its electronic element, its homepage prominence suggests management gives it time for uncertain performance to develop before reallocating resources.
As a peripheral add-on to a distant product family and only briefly mentioned on the site, it is more likely to fall below aspiration and be cut in problemistic search for better use of resources.
This seasonal platform is both distant from the core offer and low in prominence, so a conservative craft firm would be relatively likely to discontinue it if early demand is not clearly strong.
A themed Christmas pyramid builds directly on the firm’s strongest capabilities and customer expectations, so it is likely to be kept as part of the broad established range.
